newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Staburadze in demand in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Staburadze in demand in active trade.

text.p: Shares in leading Latvian confectionery maker Staburadze attracted strong demand as its price rose the most on the Riga stock exchange on Tuesday.
The rest of the market was active, with Unibanka on the official list and the Lode brick factory on the secondary list the most active stocks.
Overall turnover rose to 99,227 lats, versus 74,273 lats on December 12. The biggest official stock Unibanka remained unchanged at 2.31 lats.
Staburadze, which began trading a week ago and joined the official list, ended 31 percent higher at 1.59 lats from 1.39. This rise made it the day's strongest gainer.
Staburadze shares traded only 238 lats, but there was continued strong demand of 184,796 shares to only 882 shares supply.

"Our previous strategy of introducing good and stable shares in the official list has paid off, even given some supply problems during the initial sessions," Riga stock exchange president Uldis Cerps told a news conference.
The Lode brick factory was the most active secondary stock, turning over 13,738 lats, staying unchanged at 1.02 lats.
Other active stocks included the Daugavpils Chain factory on trade of 12,468 lats and it rose to 1.10 lats from 1.07.
Roja fish cannery traded 3698 lats of shares and also rose to 1.48 lats from 1.45 and Salacgriva 95 firm fell to 2.10 lats from 2.47 as it turned over 3738 lats of shares.
